Both modes keep the retained register PV rescale enabled and preserve original K16 groups, exact fallback, denominator ordering, reciprocal decoder, candidate envelope and collector. The ON mode owns one additional82182144-byte two-bit EXP table, generated and checked over328728576 inputs on this execution device. Other whole/MoE/FLA/CLI artifacts match the preceding register-mode1 control. Fresh real-model processes require original8192 prompt IDs, all512 GB10 output IDs, first-logit tolerance0.125 and actual streaming callbacks. Decode, suffix and long dispatch remain original. No prefix, long-context, retained-performance, package or release acceptance is inferred.

scope: Four fresh real-model q8192/out512 processes run OFF,ON,ON,OFF with the same new CK DLL. Other whole/MoE/FLA/CLI/AOT artifacts, source tables, prompt and GB10 oracle are fixed; both modes retain register PV. The sole environment difference is the combined exact-attention option. The ON route uses the prepared2x2 scalar QK schedule with complete original-dot fallback, plus a two-bit correction table generated from the SHA-bound source EXP artifact on this gfx1151 device. Every native table is independently verified over328728576 inputs before publication. Original K16 groups, ordered denominator, reciprocal decoder, PV envelope and collector remain unchanged. All512 raw output IDs, actual callbacks and first-logit tolerance0.125 attach to each run. Activation markers identify all10 eligible prefill calls, one shared EXP table initialization, and no decode activation. Two observations per mode form a limited repeated comparison. Prefix, long-context, packaged HTTP and release qualification remain separate gates.

decision.decision: Retain the combined exact attention option in the next experimental q8192 control with register PV enabled. Keep code and packaged defaults off. Profile this qualified stack once to select the next broad change against dominant completed time.
decision.rationale: Both ON observations are below both OFF controls by roughly0.88 seconds. All2048 original GB10 IDs and corresponding actual callbacks match, with the original prompt and first logit10.375 on all four runs. Initialization of the extra82182144-byte derived table remains inside actual first-callback TTFT and occurs once in each ON process. Dense and coarse correction counts remain unchanged diagnostics. Two observations per mode do not establish long-term stability.
